name: The Mountain Vein
resonance: the long climb · deep time · the wild west
note: The deep current west from Parramatta up the Nepean and the escarpment to the Three Sisters.

name: Gore Hill Cemetery

name: Sydney Park

name: The Royal Botanic Garden

desc: Ancient figs on the old Gadigal foreshore, tame and tended; a faint locus on contested neutral ground.

name: Bidjigal Reserve
resonance: the remnant bush · the hidden gully
desc: Remnant Cumberland bush along Darling Mills Creek; a quiet locus in the north-west gap.

name: Manly Dam Reserve
resonance: the dammed water · the bush at the edge
desc: Bushland around the old dam; a weak locus at the northern edge, beyond the Garigal run.

name: Cooks River
resonance: the choked river · the wild diminished
desc: The channelised urban river at Tempe, the wild all but strangled out of it; the faintest of loci.

name: Western Sydney Parklands
resonance: the made parkland · the remnant plain
desc: Remnant Cumberland Plain on the western flats at Bungarribee, half wild and half made; an unclaimed locus.

name: Nielsen Park
resonance: the harbour bush · the old shore
desc: Harbour bushland and a quiet beach at Vaucluse; a weak locus on the eastern shore.

name: The Spring Court
resonance: desire · longing · fleeting blossom
desc: The Antler Crown holds Court among the cherry blossoms, in the ache of beauty that will not last.

name: The Summer Court
resonance: wrath · the contest · the bright burning
desc: The Iron Spear musters on the old parade ground, where soldiers have drilled for war since 1841.

name: The Autumn Court
anchor: Gladesville Hospital (the old Tarban Creek asylum)
resonance: fear · dread · the cracked mind
desc: The Leaden Mirror keeps Court in the old asylum on the river, in the dread of the institution and the occult.

name: The Winter Court
resonance: sorrow · secrecy · the lonely watch
desc: The Silent Arrow withdraws to the lonely headland near the freehold, the most insular Court keeping its grief by the cold sea.
